description: This file contains unit tests for a React application's App component, using React Testing Library and React Router. It tests rendering and routing behavior for help page, login page, and authentication redirection.

methods.name: beforeEach
methods.description: Sets up the environment before each test, clearing local storage to ensure tests run without residual state.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Defines a test case; used three times for different scenarios: help page rendering, login page rendering, and redirection for unauthenticated users.
